title: Getting Started
description:
You can always find detailed instructions on our documentation website [here](https://example.com).

**Requirements**
CS2 External has certain [requirements](https://example.com/requirements) in order to run properly.

We highly recommend to follow these instructions first in order to assure smooth experience.

• [Loader Installation Requirements](https://example.com/loader)
• [System Requirements](https://example.com/system)
• [Game Client Requirements](https://example.com/client)

fields.name: First run
fields.value: Please follow [these steps](https://example.com/first-run) if you are running the software for the first time.

fields.name: Register an account
fields.value:
To use the software you must create an account in the Loader first.
Please follow [these instructions](https://example.com/register).

fields.name: Hint and Messagebox
fields.value:
If you enable this option - the software will not inject until you close two messageboxes.
You may disable these messageboxes from appearing during launching. This will make start process smoother.
To do this just toggle off `Hint and Messagebox` option in the Loader before you start the game.
